data.name: Uzziel
data.gender_notes: Uzziel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Uzziel is derived from the Hebrew words ‘ez (help) and el (God). This name was given to a Levite priest who assisted the high priest Eleazar during the consecration of the tabernacle in the wilderness (Numbers 3:27, Numbers 3:31). In Hebrew tradition, Uzziel is considered a helper of God, and as a result, it was given as a name to those who assisted or served in the temple.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of assistance and divine help
data.etymology: Uzziel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uzziel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: עוזיאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עוזיאל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אל שלי עוז' או 'עוז של אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'עוז' שפירושו כוח או עוצמה, ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם עוזיאל מופיע בתנ"ך כבן של קהת, אחיו של עמרם ודוד פאטריארכים חשובים במשפחת הכוהנים הלויים.

in_greek.name: Οὐζιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Οὐζιήλ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος עוזיאל, που σημαίνει 'Θεός μου είναι δύναμις' ή 'Η δύναμη του Θεού'. Το όνομα αυτό εμφανίζεται στη Βίβλο ως Οὐζιήλ, γιος του Καάθ, και αναφέρεται σε σημαντικές προσωπικότητες στην οικογένεια των Λευιτών.

in_latin.name: Oziehel
in_latin.long_meaning: Oziehel, seu Uzziel, est nomen hebraicum quod interpretatur 'Deus meus est fortitudo' vel 'Fortitudo Dei mei'. Nomen hoc in Biblia invenitur, designans filium Caath et fratrem Amram, personas importantes in familia sacerdotali Levitarum.

in_english.name: Uzziel
in_english.meaning: God is my strength or power
in_english.long_meaning: Uzziel is a Hebrew name that means 'God is my strength' or 'God's power'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'oz' meaning strength or power, and 'El' meaning God. In the Bible, Uzziel is mentioned as the son of Kohath and the brother of Amram, making him an important figure in the lineage of the Levitical priesthood. The name Uzziel has been used in Christian tradition to signify spiritual strength and divine support.

data.cultural_impact: The name Uzziel has been in use throughout history, particularly in Jewish culture, and was given to children to signify their role as helpers of God or those who served in the temple. The name continued to be used in Christian communities and is still used today.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Uzziel holds great spiritual significance, representing the idea that every individual has a role to play in serving and assisting God. It serves as a reminder of the importance of humility, dedication, and service in our relationship with Him. The name Uzziel also symbolizes the idea of being a vessel for God's will and using our talents and abilities to glorify Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Uzziel, meaning "my strength is God," embodies the faith and trust in divine power during times of struggle and hardship. This name serves as a reminder that even in the face of adversity, one's strength ultimately comes from God.

biblical_reference.note: Uzziel is mentioned in the book of Exodus as a son of Kohath and a brother of Amram.

historical_references.context: Uzziel is listed as the head of a division of temple musicians during the reigns of King David and his son Solomon.
